source: AA SL 2024 May P1 TZ1 Q6

parts.label: a
parts.description: Find S_n for a geometric sequence with first term 1 and common ratio 10.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Show that the sum S_1 + ... + S_n equals [10(10^n - 1) - 9n]/81.
parts.notes: A1 for writing the sum of S_i terms. M1 for using the geometric series formula and collecting the -1 terms. A1 for the powers-of-10 sum and -n. A1 for a correct intermediate expression leading to the given result.

source: AA SL 2025 May P1 TZ1 Q6

parts.label: a_i
parts.description: Show that the area of frame F_n is 20(9/4)^(n-1) cm^2.
parts.notes: M1 for recognizing width and height scale by 3/2 or that areas are geometric. A1 for first term 20 and common ratio 9/4.

parts.label: a_ii
parts.description: Find the mean area of ten frames in the requested form.
parts.notes: M1 for using a geometric sum. A1 for sum = 16((9/4)^10 - 1). A1 for dividing by 10 to get (8/5)((9/4)^10 - 1).

parts.label: b
parts.description: Find the median area of the ten picture frames.
parts.notes: M1 for recognizing the median is between the fifth and sixth terms. A1 for the correct average setup. A1 for q = 65/2.

source: AA SL 2025 May P2 TZ1 Q8

parts.label: a
parts.description: Write down t_3 from the card pyramid diagrams.

parts.label: b
parts.notes: M1 for adding 11 cards to t_3 or considering all four rows. A1 for 26.

parts.label: c
parts.notes: M1 for recognizing an arithmetic sum such as 2+5+8+... . M1 for using the sum formula. A1 for obtaining n(3n+1)/2.

parts.label: d
parts.description: Find the maximum rows possible from 14 full packs.
parts.notes: M1 for solving n(3n+1)/2 <= 728 or equivalent. A1 for critical value 21.864... or checking t_21 and t_22. A1 for 21 rows.

parts.label: e
parts.description: Find the minimum rows for a complete pyramid stack using full packs with no cards left over.
parts.notes: M1 for listing sufficient t_n values or recognizing n(3n+1)/(2*52) must be an integer. A1 for 13.

parts.label: f
parts.description: Find the minimum number of cards for a stack with vertical height more than 2 metres.
parts.notes: M1 for using trigonometry/Pythagoras to find row height. A1 for 44sqrt(3) mm. M1 for solving 44n sqrt(3) > 2000 or equivalent. A1 for 27 rows. A1 for t_27 = 1107.

parts.notes: A1 for substituting n=5 into 5000+189n to get 5945.

parts.label: b_i
parts.description: Amount in Jess's account after 5 years at 3% compounded annually.
parts.notes: M1 for 5000(1.03)^5 or equivalent GDC setup. A1 for 5796 to nearest dollar.

parts.label: c_i
parts.description: Expression for Jess's amount after n years.
parts.notes: M1 for compound-interest model with annual compounding. A1 for 5000(1.03)^n.

parts.label: c_ii

parts.notes: M1 for setting 5000(1.03)^n > 5000+189n or equivalent. M1 for solving/checking crossover values. A1 for 17 years.
